title: Multitouch activation sequence for cross-team announcement
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary:
This ticket defines a coordinated, multi-channel activation sequence so engineering, design, content, and growth can reliably publish blog, email, social, and webinar assets for the upcoming console-2025.03 launch. Goal is to minimize last-minute mismatches between release notes, SDK docs, and public-facing assets; reduce customer confusion; and ensure observability hooks (dashboard links, post-launch KPIs) are wired before publish.

Scope:
- Coordinate canonical release notes, developer Quickstart, blog post, product announcement email, social kit (thread + short clips), and webinar (slides + registration).
- Define timeline, handoffs, approvals, and fallbacks for each asset.
- Ensure change log and API docs are updated and linked in announcement assets.
- Prep rollback guidance and messaging in case of regressions.

Non-goals:
- Copywriting for long-form blog (handled in separate content ticket).
- Deep technical runbook for infra rollback (ENG runbook ticket).

Core deliverables:
- Canonical release notes doc that all channels reference (Drive link in assets).
- Channel checklist with owner and publish window.
- Single-source asset tracker (spreadsheet) with publish status, final URLs, and QA sign-offs.
- Webinar brief and Q/A doc for product/engineering reps.

Stakeholders and roles:
- Product (owner/PS): Liam Chen (assignee) — overall launch conductor and approvals.
- Content: Maya Singh — blog + email drafts.
- Design: Noor Patel — hero images, social cards, webinar slides.
- Engineering: Priya Rao — release readiness, API changes, SDK release PRs.
- Growth / Marketing: Jonah Reyes — email send, social scheduling, tracking tags.
- Support / CS: Marcus Kim — canned responses and escalation path.
- Legal / Security (as needed): Claire O'Neill — compliance review.

Activation timeline (high level):
- 2025-03-05: Kickoff and canonical release-notes draft (owner: Liam).
- 2025-03-11: Design assets first pass and blog outline due (owner: Noor, Maya).
- 2025-03-14: Internal review — PM, Eng, Design signoffs required.
- 2025-03-18: Final assets uploaded to Drive + social snippets locked.
- 2025-03-20 10:00 UTC: Staged publish window begins — release notes and developer docs go live.
- 2025-03-20 10:15 UTC: Blog post published and promoted.
- 2025-03-20 10:30 UTC: Marketing email send (segment: active-developers).
- 2025-03-21 16:00 UTC: Webinar live (recording posted within 24h).

Channel-specific handoffs and fallbacks:
- Release notes / Docs: Owner Priya. Must be merged and tagged in the docs repo by 2025-03-19 23:59 UTC. Fallback: publish a short changelog stub linking to PRs if full docs blocked.
- Blog: Owner Maya. If blog not ready by publish window, publish a short announcement pointing to release notes and schedule the long-form blog within 48h.
- Email: Owner Jonah. Email content must reference canonical release-notes URL. If breaking regressions are detected in the final 2 hours, hold the send and switch to a targeted holdback segment (beta customers only).
- Social: Owner Noor + Jonah. Post threads, video clips and cards; schedule with Buffer/Partner tool. If assets missing, publish text-first posts linking to release notes and follow up with cards later.
- Webinar: Owner Maya + Priya. Registration page live by 2025-03-12. If a key engineer becomes unavailable, product will lead the Q/A.

Asset tracker (single-source):
- Location: Drive > Launchs > console-2025.03 > assets (shared).
- Required columns: asset, owner, status, final URL, QA signoff (initials + date), backup copy link.

QA and readiness checks before go-live (must be green):
- Release notes link resolves and includes migration steps.
- SDK packages published to npm/pypi and linked from docs.
- Demo app in examples repo updated and smoke-tested.
- Monitoring dashboard and alert links included in PRD and Console announcement card.

KPIs to monitor (post-publish 72h):
- Blog pageviews and time-on-page.
- Release notes unique viewers and developer doc flows.
- Email open rate and click-through to release notes.
- Webinar registrants and attendees.
- Any uptick in support tickets related to the launch; triage within 24h.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Docs are out-of-sync with shipped SDKs. Mitigation: Block email/social until SDK release PRs are merged; if blocked, publish short note with links to PRs and timeline.
- Risk: Unexpected latency/bug on launch day. Mitigation: Hold marketing sends; alert SRE and run rollback checklist; use canned messaging from Support.
- Risk: Asset ownership confusion. Mitigation: Single spreadsheet + PM-run daily standups during final week.

Acceptance criteria (before publish window):
- All items in the asset tracker are marked 'QA signoff' by their owners.
- The docs link is live and resolves in incognito.
- Marketing email approved by product and legal.
- Two cross-team rehearsals completed for webinar (slides + Q/A).

Follow-ups after launch:
- 72-hour data review session with Growth, Product, and Eng to evaluate KPIs and decide on amplification.
- Postmortem doc created within 7 days with lessons learned and suggested improvements to the activation sequence.

Notes and artifacts (links):
- Canonical release notes (Drive): https://drive.google.com/example/console-2025-03-release-notes
- Asset tracker (Drive): https://drive.google.com/example/console-2025-03-assets
- Webinar registration (Google Forms): https://forms.gle/example-webinar
- Dev docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1456

Next steps (owner assignments):
- Liam: finalize canonical release notes and share with Priya for API verification by 2025-03-11.
- Maya: draft blog/email outlines by 2025-03-08.
- Noor: deliver social card concepts by 2025-03-10.
- Jonah: set up email segment and tracking tags by 2025-03-15.
- Priya: coordinate SDK publish and doc links by 2025-03-19.
